# docker_hub_repository_immutable_tags (Resource)

Manages tag immutability settings for a Docker Hub repository.

When enabled, tags matching the specified rules cannot be overwritten or deleted. Up to 5 rules (Go-compatible regular expressions) are supported. Rules default to `[".*"]` (all tags immutable) when enabled and no rules are specified.

This resource can be used independently of `docker_hub_repository` to manage immutable tag settings on repositories that were not created by Terraform.

-> **Note**: Requires a Personal Access Token (PAT) with the `repo:admin` scope, or an OAT with the `scope-repository-settings-admin` permission.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "docker_hub_repository_immutable_tags" "example" {
  namespace = "my-organization"
  name      = "my-repo"
  enabled   = true
  rules     = ["latest", "v[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+.*"]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) Repository namespace (organization or username)
- `name` (String) Repository name

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether tag immutability is enabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `rules` (List of String) List of Go-compatible regular expressions defining which tags are immutable. Up to 5 rules. Defaults to `[".*"]` (all tags) when enabled and no rules are specified.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import docker_hub_repository_immutable_tags.example my-organization/my-repo
```
